w3lib_286.issue:
remove_tags() is quadratic on an unterminated tag

remove_tags("<" + "a" * n), i.e. a single "<" followed by a long run of non-space characters and no closing ">", takes time that grows quadratically with n. Repair this performance problem while preserving the existing behavior of remove_tags() on normal HTML.

This is a development diagnostic with a solution-redacted issue, not the verbatim upstream issue.

w3lib_288.issue:
get_meta_refresh() is super-linear on a crafted <meta> tag

get_meta_refresh("<meta " + "http-equiv refresh " * n + ">"), a single <meta> tag that repeats the words "http-equiv refresh" n times, takes time that grows super-linearly with n. Repair this performance problem while preserving the existing behavior of get_meta_refresh() on normal HTML.

This is a development diagnostic with a solution-redacted issue, not the verbatim upstream issue.

w3lib_289.issue:
unquote_markup() is quadratic on unclosed CDATA sections

unquote_markup("<![CDATA[x" * n), many CDATA openings with no closing "]]>", takes time that grows quadratically with n. Repair this performance problem while preserving the existing behavior of unquote_markup() on normal input, including properly closed CDATA sections.

This is a development diagnostic with a solution-redacted issue, not the verbatim upstream issue.
